title: psychotria harmandiana
intro: Psychotria harmandiana, commonly known as Vietnamese mint or Vietnamese tea, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu, offering potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Psychotria harmandiana are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
